glossary.MLOps: Practices for deploying, monitoring, versioning, and maintaining machine-learning systems.
glossary.LLMOps: MLOps practices specialized for large language models, including serving and prompt or model versioning.
glossary.registry: A versioned store used to distribute container images or model artifacts.
glossary.inference: Running a trained model to produce a prediction or generated output.
glossary.GPU scheduling: Assigning limited GPU resources to workloads so training and inference can run reliably.
